header: "ARE YOU AN EXECUTIVE?": shown above the results when a signed-out visitor asks a question of the EDS kind (the rule and the two answers are in src/lib/search/loginHints.ts). Yes: he is told to sign in and the sign-in window opens at once (Yes IS the click on Sign in: there is no second card and no second click; the caller opens the window). No: the simple answer is shown at once. I search nothing until he has answered.

symbols.name: OmniExecutiveAsk
symbols.sig: export function OmniExecutiveAsk({ ask, onYes, onNo }: { ask: ExecutiveAsk; onYes: () => void; onNo: () => void })

params.name: { ask, onYes, onNo }
params.type: { ask: ExecutiveAsk; onYes: () => void; onNo: () => void }

behaviours: it asks 'Are you an executive?' in a labelled group, says what kind of question it is (several circulars into one written summary, with sources), and offers Yes and No
before the answer there is no sign-in message and no Sign in button
it says what No gives: the simple answer
after Yes there is NO second card and NO Sign in button (Yes itself opens the login window, the caller does that): Yes is shown as chosen and No stays available

pressed without a question it says what EDS is and that it is for executives, still asks 'Are you an executive?', and says No goes back to the ordinary search (not 'the simple answer', not the circulars)
the same for the pressed EDS button: after Yes no sign-in card either
the component takes no sign-in handler any more (Yes is the click on Sign in)
